description: Application pages: every Visual Builder page in the project (Old, New and Next EquipRite, Mobile, Future), each with a technical sheet read from its code — screenshot, features (sections, fields, actions, columns), business logic (action chains and rules modules), integrations (REST calls to EquipRite REST, Fusion, OIC, BI Publisher, Jira; reports; desktop services) and links — plus an AI explanation, and the Jira stories mapped to it. Kept in git (resources/pages), so everyone has the same sheets and mappings; a page mapped to another story keeps its sheet. Building a sheet, mapping, screenshots and AI text need the desktop app or npm run serve (desktop/lib/pages.js, /__pages/*). Each REST call and BI Publisher report can be tested against the real backend from here (Test, Check all reads; desktop/lib/apiTest.js, /__api/*).

info.description: The local server: answers, can write into the project, can capture screenshots (desktop app); data: the git branch the sheets are kept on ({ separate, branch, reason }, lib/dataBranch.js).

pages.description: The catalog: [{ id, app, appName, flow, page, label, route, stories, sheet }].

appF.description: The app shown: all, or an app id (vbredwoodapp, equiprite, equiprite-next, …).

showDeleted.description: Also list the pages deleted from the catalog.

deleted.description: The open page was deleted from the catalog.

viewer.description: The screenshot shown full size (its index), -1 when none.

view.description: The tab: page (its sheet), map (where it is opened from and where it goes), global (the whole app's navigation) or fix (Code Fix).

selId.description: The page whose sheet is open.

sheet.description: Its sheet: { id, facts, ai, screenshot, stories, at, by, codeHash }.

saved.description: The sheet is saved (else: the facts read now, not yet built).

commit.description: Commit and push to git after each change.

result.description: The last action's result: { ok, text }.

fixInfo.description: Code Fix (desktop/lib/codeFix.js): the code folder, its branch, whether screenshots and folder picking work here.

fixList.description: The fixes asked for on the open page, newest first.

fix.description: The fix shown: the AI's analysis, its edits as a diff, the checks, preview, what was applied and tested.

fixReq.description: What should change on the page (the request typed).

fixRefine.description: What to change in the proposal (asked again).

fixResult.description: The last Code Fix action's result: { ok, text, canSkipPull, canForce }.

fixImages.description: Screenshots pasted, dropped or attached to the request: [{ name, mime, base64, url, w, h, size }] (codeFixClient.prepImage).

fixView.description: The screenshot shown full size in the Code fix dialog (its URL), '' when none.

fixScope.description: Code fix: this page (ask, propose, approve), or all — the change history of every page.

fixHist.description: The change history: every change, here and shared from other PCs (desktop/lib/codeFix.js history()).

fixHistInfo.description: { shared, branch }: whether the history is shared through the data branch.

fixHistQ.description: What is searched for in the change history.

codePage.description: Page code tab: the page whose files are listed.

codeInfo.description: Its files: { folder, files: [{ path, name, lines, group: page | chain | module }] } (desktop/lib/pages.js code()).

codeFind.description: What is searched for in it.

apiPage.description: API tester (desktop/lib/apiTest.js): the page apiLast and apiReports belong to.

apiLast.description: The last run of each of its calls and reports ({ key: { status, ms, ok, rows, shape, at } }), shown beside each.

apiReports.description: Its BI Publisher reports read from its code: [{ name, path, params, rowTag, key, guessed }].

apiOpen.description: The call open in the tester (its endpoint, or report:<path>); '' when none.

apiDesc.description: What it sends: { op (parameters, body, reads), backend (address, login), saved (the values last used), suggest (values seen in answers) }.

apiRes.description: The answer: status, time, size, rows (table), pretty body, headers, shape against the example, curl.

apiTab.description: The answer shown as: data (its rows), body, headers, shape, curl.

apiConfirm.description: A call that changes data waits for 'Send it'.

apiMsg.description: { ok, text }: what the tester says (not sent, copied, …).

apiCheck.description: Check all: { results: [{ endpoint, state: ok | warn | fail | skip, status, ms, rows, note }], passed, warned, failed, skipped }.

focusRequest.description: From resources/js/shellBus.js focus(): another screen (a Jira story) handed this one a page to open.

scopeChanged.description: The build in scope was changed in Build.Rite's top bar (shellBus.onScope): the list shows that build.

fixImages.description: The page module read screenshots pasted, dropped or attached in the Code fix request (codeFixClient.queueImages): the chain takes them.
